text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain deferred P3, with ownership decision before implementation. Current generic pipeline graph/runners exist, but current fmri-workflow has no complete persisted study-to-pipeline lowering/resume implementation. The original command to lower into ScalaFIM PipelineGraph conflicts with unresolved pipeline-retirement/workflow-boundary RFEs already linked as prerequisites; treat that destination as historical, not mandated. Preserve scheduler-neutral scientific work descriptors, bounded interpreter capabilities and local artifact transactions in ScalaFIM; choose the orchestration owner before adding durable attempts/cache/run lifecycle. No cluster or app framework is needed for core fit/estimate qualification. On resumption require concrete fresh-process resume and fault/idempotency evidence, not merely graph construction or deterministic IDs. This is integration scope, not a current core numerical defect; do not let it block PHRF or core persistence.
